violations.title: Nonfood-Contact Surfaces Kept Clean
violations.observation: The nonfood-contact surfaces of the following equipment had accumulations of grime and debris: Soda dispenser inner wall
violations.corrective_action: Nonfood-contact surfaces of equipment and utensils shall be cleaned at a frequency necessary to preclude accumulation of soil residues. CFM cleaned and sanitized the inner wall of the soda dispenser

out_items.name: Physical facilities installed, maintained, and clean

violations.title: Physical Facilities, Maintain Good Repair
violations.observation: Observed that the floor on women’s bathroom is not maintained in good repair. Observed a crack in the center of the women’s bathroom floor, elevated humidity, and missing or deteriorated floor sealant in several areas.
violations.corrective_action: Repair the physical facilities. Poor repair and maintenance compromises the functionality of the physical facilities. CFM will repair or replace the cracked section of the bathroom floor as needed. Remove deteriorated or missing sealant and apply new, appropriate floor sealant to all affected areas. Identify and correct the source of elevated humidity, such as inadequate ventilation or moisture intrusion. Inspect the surrounding flooring for additional moisture damage and address any findings.

violations.title: Cooling from Ambient to 41F, No More than 4 Hours
violations.observation: The following food item prepared from ambient air temperature ingredients is not being adequately cooled to 41F or less within 4 hours: Observed Cut lettuce (4.5 hrs) in unit # 5
violations.corrective_action: Time/temperature control for safety food shall be cooled within 4 hours to 41F or less if prepared from ingredients at ambient air temperature (i.e. reconstituted foods and canned tuna).CFM discarded cut lettuce

violations.title: Cold Holding
violations.observation: The following food item(s) were observed cold holding at improper temperatures using a calibrated food temperature measuring device:Observed cheese in unit # 3 at 45F
violations.corrective_action: Time/temperature control for safety food shall be held cold at a temperature of 41F or below unless the permit holder is using 'time as public health control as specified under section 3-501.19 to limit bacteria growth. CFM discarded cheese from unit # 3
